verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents several public APIs that can drive the product. Its API page lists write actions such as updating candidate information, adding attachments, and advancing, moving or rejecting applications. It also documents a Job Board API with JSON access, a Candidate Ingestion API, an Assessment Partner API and webhooks. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, but that thins the AI-native ergonomics rather than contradicting the API itself. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt/markdown), detail on auth and endpoint coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
